# axonops_cassandra_scheduled_repair (Data Source)

Reads a Cassandra scheduled repair configuration by tag.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the Cassandra cluster.
- `tag` (String) The tag identifying the scheduled repair.

### Read-Only

- `blacklisted_tables` (List of String) List of tables excluded from repair.
- `incremental` (Boolean) Whether incremental repair is enabled.
- `job_threads` (Number) Number of job threads.
- `keyspace` (String) The keyspace being repaired.
- `nodes` (List of String) List of specific nodes to repair.
- `optimise_streams` (Boolean) Whether stream optimisation is enabled.
- `parallelism` (String) Repair parallelism mode.
- `paxos_only` (Boolean) Whether only Paxos repair runs.
- `primary_range` (Boolean) Whether primary range repair is enabled.
- `repair_id` (String) The ID of the scheduled repair.
- `schedule_expr` (String) Cron expression for the repair schedule.
- `segmented` (Boolean) Whether segmented repair is enabled.
- `segments_per_node` (Number) Number of segments per node.
- `skip_paxos` (Boolean) Whether Paxos repair is skipped.
- `specific_data_centers` (List of String) List of specific data centers to repair.
- `tables` (List of String) List of tables to repair.
